g.title: The way of a mail
g.text: Dynamic diagram · boring-mailstack · in (1-5) and out (6-9)

g.title: provider
g.text: Receives your mail, keeps all of it,
sends it out under your address

g.title: getmail
g.text: Fetches new mail, folder by folder;

g.title: stalwart
g.text: Sieve filter; IMAP for other clients

g.title: provenance
g.text: placed, so filters leave it alone

g.title: legend
g.text: getmail fetches a copy of each new mail,
folder by folder; the provider keeps it.
It hands the mail and its folder to the bridge.
Inbox mail is delivered: your filter sorts it.
The provider's Junk stays junk (unless your
filter says otherwise); any other folder: the
mail is put where you had filed it there.
Stalwart shows it to the webmail
The webmail hands it to Stalwart.
Stalwart passes it to the relay.
The relay sends it through your provider,
with your login there; the provider delivers
What you had filed at the provider.
What you move, copy or file here yourself.
A changed filter re-sorts old mail, but never these.
Blue box · what you see and use
